Theorem
[Volume of an ideal polygonal cone] \group ideal-cone-volume Source: thurston:page-0178, thurston:page-0179

1. Theorem 7.2.3For an ideal cone $\Sigma _{\alpha _1,\ldots ,\alpha _n}$ on a planar $n$-gon, the base dihedral angles satisfy \[ \sum _{i=1}^n\alpha _i=\pi , \qquad \operatorname {Vol}(\Sigma _{\alpha _1,\ldots ,\alpha _n})=\sum _{i=1}^n\Lambda (\alpha _i). \]
Proof

\sketch Induct on $n$, splitting the base polygon into a triangle and an $(n-1)$-gon. The new angles are $\beta $ and $\pi -\beta $; apply the induction hypothesis to both cones and cancel $\Lambda (\pi -\beta )=-\Lambda (\beta )$.

□
